_comment: invrisil_walkthrough's start (FIXTURE-FIRST). Same door-chain/awakening accomplishments as near_riverfarm (door_awakened already banked, standing at the SAME free cell (13,6) facing the awakened pantry_door at (14,6), against the east wall) PLUS the Invrisil attunement chain: invrisil_attuned banks from Eloise's stone purchase in real play (riverfarm_witch.json's 'shop' node, gated on blight_lifted), so the CHAIN is pre-banked whole -- riverfarm_attuned + blight_lifted + invrisil_attuned together, with invrisil_attunement_stone in inventory (test_fixture_coherence.gd's monotone arms enforce exactly this implication set; a position holding the stone without the chain, or vice versa, is unreachable). CONSEQUENCE: Riverfarm enters the portal menu too -- the script's beat-1 pick is index 2 (Liscor, Riverfarm, Invrisil, 'Let it be.'), traced in its own comment. player_skills carries the SAME QA-fixture-only `sneak`/`observe` grant stealth_loop already established (no shipped class grants sneak this early; a real [Rogue] earn supersedes it later) -- needed to exercise the sneak-positive leg of the alley footpads. `classes: {warrior: 2}` is set DIRECTLY (bypassing gained_by/won_combat -- fixtures may preload state, the near_rogue/near_evolution precedent) to MATCH the combat data's own tuning baseline verbatim: the alley_footpads roster's gated 0.75-0.98 win band (combatants.json's own _comment) was measured at 'warrior2 SOLO' specifically -- a classless L1 PC with a rusty_sword and no combat skills is a materially weaker matchup than that tuned baseline and was confirmed (first attempt) to lose outright at seed 9. known_skills() derives class skills from the `classes` dict dynamically (WIProgression.granted_skills), so warrior2 here correctly fields basic_swordwork/tough_body/power_strike/piercing_strikes/counter_strike/battle_momentum without needing won_combat to have organically fired first. rng_state IS load-bearing here (unlike stealth_loop's own cosmetic seed) since the sneak-negative leg resolves a real fight. TRAP: rng_state is a properly-derived state (.seed=9, captured .state -- the same value seed=9 resolves to everywhere else in this repo), never hand-typed -- WISave restores .state directly, not .seed, so a hand-typed small int would collapse the first randi() draw to a degenerate output; invrisil_walkthrough wins the sneak-negative fight cleanly at warrior2 off this state. met_relc/sparred_with_relc/given_spear_by_relc are banked as the tutorial history any Liscor-reaching PC necessarily has (harmless to the build: `classes` is set DIRECTLY per the note above, not via gained_by/won_combat, and no sleep occurs in this canonical, so sparred_with_relc's gained_by trigger never re-fires). KNOWN GAP: post_game here is missing the rest of the Act-III backbone (reached_two_classes/the raskghar chain) it structurally implies elsewhere -- deliberately NOT enriched, since `classes: {warrior: 2}` above is LOCKED to the alley_footpads combat-tuning baseline and adding a second class to earn reached_two_classes would shift that measured win rate off-band; closing it needs a combat-tuning re-measure, never a bare fixture edit (test_fixture_coherence.gd carries the matching exemption + an exact-build check).
